annotations.title: Send the author a note on a passage

description: SIDE EFFECT: emails the author of the book a private note about one passage (a correction, a question, a remark), from the signed-in person, and keeps it in their notes on the site. The author can reply to the person's email. Use only when the person asks, with their words. `quote` must be copied exactly from the chapter (it finds the paragraph). Needs INITE ID sign-in with the mikefluff:discuss scope and a chapter the person may read. At most 30 notes a day per person. Nothing is published.

locale.description: Edition of the book the passage is from.

note.description: What the person wants to tell the author.

quote.description: The passage, exactly as it is in the chapter.

name: send_note_to_author
